alias_policy.claim: New unscored GDP-ID groups with known-alias exclusions; physical_alias_resolution_verified=false if any reserved alias unresolved; statistical_independence=false.
alias_policy.exclude: Every reserved GDP ID; every known positive reserved WMO; every already selected GDP ID/WMO. No replacement after selection.
alias_policy.missing_reserved_alias: Retain exact unresolved reserved IDs and counts; do not block new candidates solely because old aliases are unresolved.
alias_policy.new_candidate: One positive canonical WMO per ID, one canonical GDP ID per WMO in frozen global metadata; candidate snapshot WMO must agree.

assignment.development: All existing exposed IDs are development/excluded only. No shared model is fitted from them in this study.
assignment.evaluation: Every selected whole GDP ID and its complete day remain evaluation-group data.
assignment.prefix_adaptation: Each fixed algorithm can estimate its state/parameters only from its own first18 positions. These are allowed observation context, not cross-ID training.

exclusions.rule: Re-derive from every pinned existing public CSV/JSON, including unscored metadata candidates; do not alter the snapshot or pre-existing fixtures.

limitations: QC/interpolated historical NOAA positions may use future raw fixes upstream: operational_causality=false.
Same-date nearby drifters and unresolved old WMO aliases prevent claims of statistical independence.
No current forcing, observed plastic identity, physical tank trial, ecological benefit or source attribution.
No model promotion, significance claim, hyperparameter tuning, camera/provider/message actions.

metrics.ade_m: Mean six great-circle errors; primary equal-GDP-ID macro mean.
metrics.failure_policy: Preserve every six-slot group/model/horizon cell; acquisition/model/missing truth failures stay failed or unfilled. No silent successful subset ranking.
metrics.fde_m: Sixth-hour great-circle error; primary equal-GDP-ID macro mean.
metrics.primary: Withhold every common-target model metric if any of 180 target model/horizon outcomes is missing/failed; successful per-group rows remain visible.
metrics.uncertainty: Kalman observed ellipse uses Pxy+assumedR; nominal50/90 per-group counts only, never calibrated confidence.
metrics.vector_rmse_m_s: RMS local interval displacement residual / actual interval seconds; first predicted anchor filtered for Kalman, raw for others.

models.forecast_anchor: Kalman filtered final prefix state; other models raw final prefix position.

pre_outcome_amendment.claim: Previously unscored GDP-ID groups with known-alias exclusions and unseen future positions at selection; not IDs never appearing in selection metadata.
pre_outcome_amendment.exposure: V1 exposed selection-origin metadata and an identifier-only global ID/WMO registry, never trajectories or forecast truth/outcomes.
pre_outcome_amendment.preserved: Original223exclusions, blocks, fixed models, strict alias/selection gates and all v1 raw/failure receipts.
reason: Two v1 metadata streams reached HTTP200 but ReadTimeout before body bytes.
One complete v1 metadata snapshot declared expno unit count; a new-parser empty-unit expectation rejected it.
pre_outcome_amendment.registry_exemption: Fresh-study v1/v2 metadata registries are not training evidence or new exclusion universes. Re-derive the unchanged original28-fixture/223-ID snapshot excluding both lineage directories.

preprocessing.eligibility: Exact requested ID/24 hourly UTC rows. Prefix map domain failures retained, never replaced. Do not exclude future truth by displacement/error.

protocol.purpose: Fixed algorithms on new previously unscored GDP-ID groups with known-alias exclusions; not proven statistically independent or alias-complete physical drifters.

selection.method: First two eligible canonical GDP IDs in ascending numeric order per ordered block; exclude reserved/known-alias/shared-selected/ambiguous IDs before sorting.

limitations: New previously unscored canonical GDP-ID groups with known-alias exclusions, not proven physically or statistically independent.
All existing exposed fixture IDs are excluded; no cross-ID/shared training or held-out tuning is performed.
18 prefix positions are permitted observation context for each fixed algorithm, not evaluation labels for shared fitting.
NOAA hourly positions are QC/interpolated historical estimates; upstream raw-fix causality is not established.
Assumed Kalman noise and ellipse spread are uncalibrated; no source probability or physical benefit follows.
No matched current forcing, observed plastic labels, source/prevention mutation, camera access or provider calls.
